purpose: Teach: 義理/絶好/いたずら/惚れ/忘年会/着せ/クビ/真っ先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、義理の父にも、礼を尽くしたな。
lines.en: When I was young, I showed proper respect to my wife's father too.
lines.style: Quiet, measured voice. A slight pause before speaking, as if retrieving the memory from a long way back. Even pacing, gentle. The weight of decades behind a simple sentence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あなたとの結婚、絶好の選択だったわ。
lines.en: Yes. Marrying you was the best decision I ever made.
lines.style: Soft and warm, but not sentimental. A fact stated with the certainty of someone who has lived it. Her voice settles on 'best' with quiet conviction. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫のいたずらで、毎日笑ってる。
lines.en: Every day the grandkids pull some prank and I find myself laughing.
lines.style: Dry amusement underneath. The weariness of age mixed with genuine delight. Slightly slower on 'pull some prank' — like he's still bemused by his own susceptibility to being fooled.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若かりし頃、あなたに惚れた瞬間、覚えてるわ。
lines.en: I still remember the exact moment, when I was young, that I fell in love with you.
lines.style: Voice becomes tender, almost vulnerable. Slower pace. The words are deliberate, precious — each one placed carefully. A long marriage behind this simple admission.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 忘年会、近所の仲間と毎年やっていた。
lines.en: The year-end parties with the neighbors — we did those every single year.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia. Slight trailing-off at the end, like he's seeing the gatherings in his mind. Warm but tinged with the quiet sadness of something that no longer happens.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 子供たちに、いつも晴れ着、着せた。
lines.en: I always dressed the children in their formal clothes for those occasions.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet pride and care. Matter-of-fact surface, but underneath is the tenderness of a mother making sure her children were seen beautifully. Even, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: バブル崩壊で、私もクビ寸前だったな。
lines.en: During the bubble collapse, I almost lost my job too.
lines.style: Factual, but with underlying tension just beneath the surface. Not dwelling on it. A slight exhale before speaking, as if saying it aloud is necessary but not easy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 真っ先にあなたを支えると決めていたわ。
lines.en: I decided right then — I would support you, first and foremost.
lines.style: Warm and resolute, but not dramatic. The steadiness of someone who made a choice and kept it. Voice has the weight of fidelity. Close, intimate delivery, as if speaking directly to him across the years.
